---
section_label: 'ABOUT MAE SOM'
---

Mae Som has been working her wok on the same corner since **1987**.
What started as a small neighbourhood food stall is today a must-visit
for street-food lovers from all over the world.

She cooks **everything herself, fresh, right in front of you** — no
mise en place from the cold room, no microwave, no shortcuts. She grinds
the peanuts in the morning and boils her own tamarind concentrate twice a week.

What you taste here is 38 years of devotion on a plate.
